interpretive_status: illustrative; not calibrated to real-world agentic-AI failure frequencies
systemic_contagion_definition: A run is classified as systemic contagion when compromise reaches at least 2 cell(s) beyond the originating governance cell.

outcomes.systemic_contagion_pct: Percentage of replications in which compromise crosses the specified governance-cell threshold.
outcomes.strategic_velocity_pct: Percentage of secondary cell-capacity remaining uncompromised over the observation window.
outcomes.accumulated_value_missing: Mean number of secondary governance cells reached by missing-value exposure.
outcomes.value_slippage: Mean cumulative compromised cell-steps before or in the absence of mediation.

fixed_dimensions.topology: fully exposed potential cross-cell interface; topology variation excluded

excluded_claim: empirical prediction of real-world failure frequency
